files.installs/sotf/gamedash-test-run.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed Sons of the Forest server — generated by provision().
# Settings: <ROOT>/installs/sotf/gamedash-servers/test/dedicatedserver.cfg
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
# keep the join password in step with the ones set in GameDash
python3 - "<ROOT>/installs/sotf/gamedash-servers/test/dedicatedserver.cfg" "$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD" <<'SYNC'
import json, sys
p = sys.argv[1]
d = json.load(open(p, encoding="utf-8-sig"))
d["Password"] = sys.argv[2]
json.dump(d, open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8"), indent=2)
SYNC
export WINEPREFIX="<ROOT>/home/.wine-gd-sotf-test"
export WINEDEBUG=-all
export WINEDLLOVERRIDES="mscoree,mshtml="   # no Mono/Gecko install prompts (headless)
# Run headless: Wine would otherwise open a console window on the desktop
# session (unsetting DISPLAY alone isn't enough — it falls back to Wayland).
unset DISPLAY
export WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-none
cd "<ROOT>/installs/sotf" || exit 1
# The server needs a display to start, so it gets an invisible virtual one.
exec xvfb-run -a -s "-screen 0 640x480x24 -nolisten tcp" wine ./SonsOfTheForestDS.exe -userdatapath "Z:<WINROOT>\\installs\\sotf\\gamedash-servers\\test"
